## ARR - Cost and iteration ceiling (N-4, N-2)

Every 15 minutes, reads the latest runs of the workflows you watch, with their run data, and checks each one's duration, how many times any node ran (agent iterations, retries) and the tokens it used. A run over a ceiling, including one still running past its time limit, stops this run with an error naming the execution.

1. In **Watched workflows**, list the ids of the agent workflows to watch.
2. In **Get executions**, choose an n8n API credential for this instance.
3. In **Check**, set the ceilings from the report (section 5).
4. **Workflow settings > Error Workflow**: pick the error workflow your other workflows use.
5. Activate.
